description: R2-C (TYPE_SIZE_DROPPED, the ODC end-to-end proof that replaced the negative setting-size-odc.json): a setting of the data text written with a size. An ODC setting keeps no Length nor Decimals (ISiteProperty writes DataType, DefaultValue, IsSecret...), so the preflight writes the type without its size, lists TYPE_SIZE_DROPPED in normalizations, and the setting applies and verifies (it was refused ODC_SETTING_SIZE before).
